input.encoding: Each node is [signed value, left child index, right child index]; -1 means no child.
input.root_index: The root can have any table index; the tree is nonempty.
input.tree_requirement: One valid nonempty rooted binary tree with every node reachable exactly once.
input.result: The largest sum over any nonempty path that follows parent-child edges; the path may start and end at any nodes.
